bullets: PROTECTION FROM THE ELEMENTS - Stay warm, dry, and comfortable all night long with the Dream 5° insulated sleeping bag. It is made with a water-resistant inner and outer shell, draft collar, tube to keep cold air out, and multiple layers of hypoallergenic synthetic fill, delivering superior insulation for temperatures as low as 5°F/-15°C.

COMFORTABLE MUMMY DESIGN - Designed to provide the most efficient insulation, our sleeping bag for cold weather boasts a relaxed mummy shape that retains heat, making it an exceptional camping sleeping bag for all of your outdoor adventures. Keep warm while you sleep under the stars for a good night’s rest, even in challenging weather conditions.

STUFF SACK INCLUDED—Your lightweight sleeping bag easily packs down to fit into the included stuff sack for easy compressed packing and carrying. Weighing only 5 lbs 1oz (Regular) or 5 lbs 5oz (Long), the Dream 5° makes an excellent backpacking sleeping bag that you can bring with you anywhere.

DIFFERENTIATED DRAW CORDS - Easy-to-adjust draw cords allow you to effortlessly modify your comfortable and warm sleeping bag even in the dark. The hood zipper is securely tied into a knot, while the side and pocket zippers lie flat, making them easy to access even in dark or low light.
ZIPPERED STASH POCKET - The side stash pocket is a safe place to store your phone, watch, lip balm, or other small essentials while you sleep.
